technical_evidence: User has administrative privilege beyond required finance duties
business_scenario: Finance employee performs reporting activities only
business_consequence: Unauthorised modification of critical finance data
assessment_rationale: Privilege level exceeds the access required for the stated business role

technical_evidence: Permission remained after transfer to another department
business_scenario: Former HR employee has moved to another business function
business_consequence: Unauthorised payroll approval or employee data changes
assessment_rationale: Historical role change indicates that the current entitlement may no longer be required

technical_evidence: External contractor account has write access although assigned work is read only
existing_control: Manager approval required for contractor access
assessment_rationale: Granted permission exceeds the documented business requirement

technical_evidence: Multiple privileged login attempts occurred outside normal working hours
business_scenario: Operations administrator normally performs privileged work during approved support windows
business_consequence: Potential misuse of privileged operational access
assessment_rationale: Observed access pattern requires contextual analyst review before organisational risk is confirmed

technical_evidence: Active service account has no documented accountable owner
business_scenario: Legacy integration remains active for scheduled data transfer
business_consequence: Unmanaged account may retain access without accountable oversight
assessment_rationale: Account ownership cannot be verified and requires organisational confirmation
